value.rationale: The decoder keeps operative list headers separate from their enumerated action clauses. Headers provide a contextual actor and an operative-list cue; action clauses retain typed actor holes and explicit cue requirements, while locally stated recipients, conditions, triggers, exceptions, and retention limits remain in the claim. A generic source-qualification cue preserves the one-month timing attached to the return duty. Training bindings distinguish the genuinely governing colon-ended header from an earlier header with identical actor/cue values, and include closed local retention controls.
